zh_cn.name: 方块地下城
zh_cn.description: 方块地下城式的俯视冒险：等距地砖与熔岩、圆角石板面板、生命条与治疗药水、1 2 3 神器冷却、灵魂和绿宝石。

en_us.name: Block Dungeons
en_us.description: A Minecraft Dungeons-style top-down adventure: isometric tiles and lava, a rounded slate bar, health and a healing potion, artifact cooldowns on 1 2 3, souls and emeralds.
